name: Phone posts the video
description: A black phone centred on the clean background plays the speaker's own video under a small 'New post' header; a cursor taps the orange 'Post now' button, it spins and turns into a green '✓ Posted', then platform chips (e.g. REELS, TIKTOK) pop out around the phone.
use_when: Lines about publishing or uploading: 'post it', 'upload it straight to your socials', 'ship it today', 'hit publish', sharing one video to several platforms.

header.help: small title at the top of the phone screen

button.help: label on the orange button before the tap

done.help: label on the green button after the tap (a check is added)

platforms.help: 0-3 short platform names shown as chips after posting, each under ~10 characters; [] for none
